# Codex Review

Target: branch diff against main

The schema and source edits are internally consistent, but the removed function remains deployed and the repository's deployment workflow does not delete it. This makes the strict production-parity check fail after merge until an unrepresented manual cleanup occurs.

Review comment:

- [P1] Delete production sitemap before reducing registry coverage — /Users/cm10/pickle-hub-pro/src/lib/__tests__/edge-auth-registry.test.ts:41-41
  When this lands while `sitemap` is still deployed, lowering the source/config/registry count to 75 guarantees `.github/workflows/edge-auth-parity.yml` will report a `production-orphan` on the main push and every nightly run. The existing deploy guard explicitly skips removed function directories and never runs `supabase functions delete`, so delete the remote function as part of the rollout/workflow or retain its registry entry until deletion is complete.
